definition_quote.value: All piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances in connection with a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance; for sanitary drainage or storm drainage facilities; or used in the installation of natural gas; and the installation, repair, maintenance, and renovation of all piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances for a supply of water or for the disposal of waste water, liquid waste, or sewage
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means: (A) All piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances: (i) In connection with a supply of water within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance on the premises and to the connection with a utility water meter or other public water utility property or other source of supply; (ii) For sanitary drainage or storm drainage facilities, including venting systems for facilities, within or adjacent to any building, structure, or conveyance and connected with a public disposal or private disposal system or other point of disposal; or (iii) Used in the installation of natural gas

methods_authorized.quote: The installation, repair, maintenance, and renovation of all piping, fixtures, appurtenances, and appliances for a supply of water or for the disposal of waste water, liquid waste, or sewage

license_tiers.quote: No person shall engage in work as a master plumber, journeyman plumber, apprentice plumber, or restricted license holder called for under this chapter or adopted rules unless first licensed or registered to do so by the Department of Health.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice plumber must be supervised by a master plumber or journeyman plumber; one master plumber or journeyman plumber may supervise up to three apprentice plumbers on a single job
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: an apprentice plumber shall not engage in plumbing unless he or she is supervised by a master plumber or a journeyman plumber

apprentice_unsupervised_training_year_th.quote: "Final year of apprenticeship" means when an apprentice plumber has obtained four hundred eighty (480) hours or more of classroom instruction and completed six thousand (6,000) or more hours of on-the-job work in an approved United States Department of Labor apprenticeship program

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: One (1) master plumber or journeyman plumber may supervise up to three (3) apprentice plumbers on a single job.

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: An individual applying for and obtaining a license as a journeyman plumber shall be eligible for the master plumber examination after being licensed as a journeyman plumber for one (1) year.
